Cut along a diagonal; cut and slide pieces.

Goal: I can derive parallelogram and trapezoid area by splitting them into triangles.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Parallelogram: A = bh. Trapezoid: A = (1/2)h(b1 + b2).

A diagonal splits a parallelogram into two congruent triangles, each (1/2)bh, so the total is bh. A diagonal splits a trapezoid into two triangles with the same height h and bases b1 and b2, so the area is (1/2)hb1 + (1/2)hb2.

The height is the perpendicular distance between the parallel sides, not the length of a slanted side.
